name: Insurance Support
description: IRDAI-registered insurance advisory by Hari Kotian (Reg 0149161D). Expert guides on LIC, health, motor, and general insurance in India; claim recovery, appeal support, and policy advice. 25+ years experience, INR 50+ Cr claims recovered.

skills.name: Insurance Guide Search
skills.description: Answer questions about life, health, motor, and general insurance in India using the Insurance Support guide library, including premium tax benefits (80C/80D), portability, and policy comparisons.

skills.name: Claim Support Information
skills.description: Explain insurance claim processes, IRDAI regulations, the 30-day settlement rule, appeal procedures, ombudsman complaints, and IGMS filing for rejected claims.

skills.name: LIC Policy Advisor
skills.description: Guidance on LIC policies: revival of lapsed policies, maturity claims, death claim settlement, premium payment modes, and policy loans.

skills.name: Health Insurance Buyer Guide
skills.description: Help buyers choose health insurance: pre-existing disease waiting periods, restoration benefits, claim settlement ratios, senior citizen plans, and family floater vs individual coverage.
